body.name: common low-level response construction
body.construction: Fix one law of \((U_C,U_X,B,S)\) with \(P(U_C=c)=p_c\), \(B\perp(U_C,S)\), \(E[B_{cx}]=\mu_{cx}\), and \(S\sim\operatorname{Unif}[0,1]\). Fix \(C=U_C\), \(X=f_0(C,U_X)\), and \(Y=B_{C,X}\) in \(\mathcal M_R\). For input \(\gamma\in\Gamma(p,r)\), set \(s_x(c)=\gamma_{cx}/p_c\), construct \(g_s\) by inverse transform, and apply only \(\sigma_s\).
